principle: No legally usable, source-identified, fresh and verified data => no scored factor, entry conclusion or executable prediction. Missing data stays missing and must never be fabricated, imputed, silently defaulted, or replaced by stale values.

absolute_invariants.TW_MARKET_SCOPE: Only instruments and rules explicitly supported by the Taiwan model may be analysed. Unsupported security types, special trading states or market-rule exceptions must be blocked rather than forced through the common-stock model.
absolute_invariants.LEGAL_SOURCE_ONLY: Every scored or predictive input must come from a source whose access and intended use are explicitly permitted. A public URL is not by itself a licence.
absolute_invariants.NO_IMPUTATION: A missing, failed, stale, mismatched or legally-unusable source remains null/unavailable. Never replace it with zero, a guessed value, another provider's unverified value, the previous period, a synthetic value, or a model estimate pretending to be observed data.
absolute_invariants.FACT_ESTIMATE_SEPARATION: Observed facts, deterministic derived values and model estimates must be separately identified. A model output must never be displayed as an observed market fact.
absolute_invariants.TRACEABILITY: Every observed number used in scoring or prediction must be traceable to source, dataset, data date/period and verification status.
absolute_invariants.EXACT_SCHEMA_ONLY: Scored structured data may be parsed only through registered exact field names/versioned schemas. Semantic guessing of unknown field names is forbidden.
absolute_invariants.FRESHNESS: Current-state outputs require the latest completed official trading session or latest required reporting period. Calendar-age tolerance must never relabel an old session as current.
absolute_invariants.PRICE_CROSS_CHECK: Price-based prediction requires same-security, same-session official close cross-check. Any mismatch blocks the prediction.
absolute_invariants.HISTORY_COMPLETENESS: Partial historical downloads cannot silently become a valid series. Predictive models have explicit minimum history requirements; deterministic holding rules may use only the verified observations actually available and must leave unavailable structure fields null.
absolute_invariants.NO_FAKE_CONFIDENCE: Do not display calibrated probability, win probability, success rate or statistical confidence unless validated out-of-sample. A separately labelled 9+3 decision-confidence index is allowed only when it is deterministically computed from verified factor coverage and directional consistency, never represented as probability, and never filled from missing factors.
absolute_invariants.TAIWAN_MICROSTRUCTURE: All executable prices must obey Taiwan tick size, reference-price/price-limit rules, trading-session rules and active restrictions applicable to that security.
absolute_invariants.CORPORATE_ACTION_GATE: Ex-right/ex-dividend, capital reduction, split, new listing/no-limit periods or other reference-price discontinuities require explicit official adjustment before a predictive price output may use the affected series. Unknown corporate-action status must be disclosed in rule-based holding output and must never be treated as clean.
absolute_invariants.ACTIVE_RISK_STATUS: Attention/disposition/suspension states must be valid for the target trading date. Unknown status is not a clean status.
absolute_invariants.ACCOUNTING_CLASS_GATE: General, financial, insurance, securities/futures, holding-company and mixed-industry statements may not be treated as interchangeable. Unknown class receives no sector-financial score.
absolute_invariants.MODEL_VALIDATION_GATE: Predictive recommendations and statistical claims require the applicable out-of-sample validation gate. This gate must never be used to suppress deterministic holding-risk rules that are calculated only from user-supplied position facts and legally verified market facts.
absolute_invariants.HOLDING_RULES_NOT_OOS_LOCKED: Existing-position management is a deterministic rule path. It may calculate cost, verified-close P/L, risk state, and any support/resistance that can be derived from the verified bars actually available. OOS is required only for statistical claims or a separate predictive exit model, never as a prerequisite to display deterministic holding management.
absolute_invariants.FAIL_CLOSED: When a required gate cannot be evaluated, the affected result is blocked or left unavailable. Unknown is never treated as pass, but an unavailable optional enhancement must not erase unrelated verified facts.
absolute_invariants.RAW_REDISTRIBUTION: Raw official datasets may be mirrored publicly only when the specific dataset licence/authorisation permits redistribution and attribution obligations are satisfied.
absolute_invariants.AUDITABILITY: Model version, source status, data date and blockers/warnings must be visible or recoverable for every generated result.
absolute_invariants.ENTRY_DECISION_CONTRACT: Single-stock entry analysis uses one contract only: nine core entry factors plus verified US-market context, TAIFEX TX context and international-event context. No investment-horizon label may create a different buy model or replace a missing factor.
absolute_invariants.ENTRY_NINE_FACTORS: The nine visible analyst sections are: price/volume; Taiwan broad market; technical analysis (including MA/MACD/RSI/KD/candlestick/support-resistance as sub-evidence); chips/institution/margin-short; valuation; monthly revenue; quarterly earnings; financial quality; and industry/product/company momentum. Technical indicators must not be inflated into separate top-level factors.
absolute_invariants.ENTRY_EXTERNAL_CONTEXT: A complete entry conclusion requires verified US-market context, verified TAIFEX TX context and verified international-event context. Missing event data is unknown, never 'no event'.
absolute_invariants.UNIFIED_ENTRY_SCANNER: TOP10 uses the same 9+3 entry contract as single-stock analysis. It may not create separate rankings by investment horizon or silently use a different factor set.
absolute_invariants.BUY_HOLDING_SEPARATION: A buy-entry model and existing-position management are different decisions. A deep support level may not be presented as a currently executable buy price merely because it is below market.
absolute_invariants.TARGET_SESSION_BY_DATA_DATE: The model's target trading session is determined from the latest verified completed official session, not from the user's clock alone. Clock time only controls whether an order type is currently executable.
absolute_invariants.NEXT_SESSION_INPUT_COMPLETENESS: A new next-session plan may be generated only after the latest completed official session has advanced and every input required by that model for the target session has independently passed legal-source, schema, date and integrity checks. A scheduled refresh time is never proof that data is ready.
absolute_invariants.NO_INTRADAY_REPRICE_WITHOUT_LIVE_FEED: Without a legally licensed real-time or delayed market-data feed, StockLab must not create a revised same-day executable price after 09:00 or describe any stale/daily-close value as the current market price. The original plan may remain visible only as a labelled reference/audit record.
absolute_invariants.NO_UNBUYABLE_ENTRY_BANDS: A deep support level may be shown only as a wait/re-entry condition. It must not be labelled as a current buy recommendation unless the model can establish that the price is actionable for the target session.
absolute_invariants.POSITION_INPUT_PROVENANCE: Holding average cost, shares and buy date are user-supplied facts. Total cost may be deterministically derived from average cost × shares. None may be inferred from market data.
absolute_invariants.EXIT_MODEL_SEPARATION: Holding management must use the holder's user-supplied cost basis, position size and buy time plus verified 9+3 market/company evidence. A former buy band or the previous completed-session low may not be renamed or used as the numeric exit recommendation. A numeric exit trigger requires the verified 9+3 weighted decision plus sufficient legal price structure; otherwise it remains unavailable.
absolute_invariants.TOP10_REASON_REQUIRED: Every TOP10 candidate must disclose at least two source-traceable inclusion reasons and at least one material risk. A naked rank or score is insufficient.
absolute_invariants.NO_HORIZON_BUY_MODEL: StockLab must not ask the user to choose short/mid/long as a condition for entry analysis or generate multiple buy prices by investment horizon.
absolute_invariants.DIVIDEND_TRUTH: Cash dividends, stock dividends, dividend yield, distribution year and ex-right/ex-dividend dates must come from licensed verified datasets. Missing or not-yet-announced dividend fields remain unavailable and must never be converted to zero or guessed dates.
absolute_invariants.EXECUTABLE_ENTRY_ONLY: A predictive or current-session executable entry output may show only a legally verified Taiwan-market executable price after all required predictive/session gates pass. A separately labelled deterministic completed-session research reference is permitted under RULE_BASED_ENTRY_REFERENCE and must not be described as live or guaranteed executable.
absolute_invariants.THREE_INPUT_HOLDING_POSITION: Existing-position direct input requires user-observed first buy time, current shares and current average cost. Current total cost is deterministically derived as average cost × shares and must not be requested as a redundant mandatory field.
absolute_invariants.RULE_BASED_ENTRY_REFERENCE: A completed-session-derived numeric entry reference is permitted only after the verified 9+3 weighted decision is complete and sufficient legal price structure/reachability exists. It is not a live price, guaranteed executable price or probability claim. Missing 9+3/history keeps the numeric recommendation unavailable.
absolute_invariants.SECTOR_RESEARCH_SHORTLIST: The 'don't know what to buy' path may show up to five research candidates per verified industry using deterministic completed-session facts and known risk flags. This shortlist is not a predictive ranking and may not display uncalibrated win rates.
absolute_invariants.ANALYST_9PLUS3_STRUCTURE: Every new-position result page must use the same 9+3 analyst structure. The visible nine sections are the company/stock analysis body; +1 US market/SOX, +2 TAIFEX TX, +3 international events are external context. Data legality, schema, freshness, security type, risk status, accounting class and corporate actions are prerequisite gates outside the visible nine.
absolute_invariants.NO_SINGLE_PRICE_SHORTCUT: A current entry recommendation must never be created from min(close, session-average), a fixed percentage discount, or any one-bar shortcut. Completed-session OHLC may be shown as facts, but a buy zone must come from the 9+3 decision structure and, where numeric, validated market structure/reachability.
absolute_invariants.MISSING_SECTION_TRANSPARENCY: Every unavailable 9+3 section must be visibly marked unavailable. Missing is not neutral, zero, negative or positive, and may not be filled from an unregistered website, stale snapshot, heuristic, AI text or another data field.
absolute_invariants.NINE_PLUS3_WEIGHTED_ENTRY_EXIT: Any numeric new-entry recommendation or numeric holding exit trigger must pass through the same verified 9+3 evidence contract. Entry and exit may use different disclosed governance weights, but neither may substitute a previous-session low, a former short/mid/long band, a fixed price percentage or an AI guess for the 9+3 decision layer.
absolute_invariants.EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE_INDEX: Entry and exit may show a 0-100 decision-confidence index only as verified-data coverage multiplied by directional consistency under the published 9+3 weights. It is not a win rate, probability or return forecast. Missing/unverified factors reduce coverage and receive no neutral/zero imputation.
absolute_invariants.UNIFIED_WEIGHTED_ENTRY_PRICE: StockLab has one numeric new-position entry recommendation path only: the complete verified 9+3 weighted decision followed by legally usable Taiwan price structure and empirical reachability. Legacy A/B/C scenario prices, investment-horizon price bands, fixed discounts and one-bar shortcuts are forbidden.
absolute_invariants.ENTRY_PRICE_DECISION_SEPARATION: Entry Zone price geometry is a deterministic price-structure layer and must not be erased merely because a non-price 9+3 factor is unavailable. The 9+3 layer determines whether/how to act on the zone; missing 9+3 evidence must remain visible and must not be imputed.
absolute_invariants.PRICE_STRUCTURE_GATE: A numeric Entry Zone requires at least 60 legally usable verified OHLC bars plus valid Taiwan tick handling. It may not fall back to the previous close, previous low, a fixed percentage, or a one-bar heuristic.

provenance_classes.observed: Direct field from a legally permitted source after schema/date validation.
provenance_classes.user_observed: Value explicitly entered by the user, such as average cost, shares or buy date.
provenance_classes.derived: Deterministic calculation from identified observed/user-observed inputs; formula and input dates must be known.
provenance_classes.model_estimate: Forecast/decision output from verified inputs; never labelled as official data.
provenance_classes.unavailable: Missing, stale, legally blocked, schema-unknown or failed validation; never converted to a numeric factor.

holding_rules.missing_structure_behavior: Holding facts and verified-close P/L may still be shown, but no numeric 9+3 exit trigger is generated. Never fall back to the previous-session low/high, fixed percentages, stale values or synthetic structure.

buy.purpose: Provide one analyst-style Taiwan-stock 9+3 weighted entry decision from legally usable verified facts. A numeric entry interval is shown only when all 9+3 inputs pass and at least 60 legal verified OHLC bars support Taiwan-market structure/reachability. Missing evidence leaves the numeric recommendation unavailable.
forbidden: investment-horizon-specific buy models
deep support shown as current buy recommendation
real-time wording without a licensed live feed
automatic switch to tomorrow solely because clock passed 09:00 or 13:30
same-day repricing after 09:00 without a licensed live/delayed feed
filling a missing factor with guessed or stale data
treating MA/MACD/RSI/KD/candlestick as separate top-level analyst sections
single-price shortcut based on min(close, session average) or fixed discount
legacy A/B/C entry scenarios or any second/third fallback buy price
buy.time_rule: 08:30-09:00 controls whether a pre-open limit ROD plan is in its execution window. After 09:00 the same plan may remain visible only as a labelled reference/audit record; without a licensed live/delayed feed StockLab must not create a revised same-day executable price. A new next-session plan is generated only after the official latest completed-session date has advanced AND every model-required target-session input has passed its legal-source, schema, freshness and integrity gates.

holding.purpose: Manage an existing position from user-supplied cost/share/buy-time facts plus the same verified 9+3 evidence contract. Factual P/L may be shown from the latest verified completed-session close. A numeric exit trigger is shown only when 9+3 is complete and at least 60 legal verified OHLC bars support the weighted MA/ATR/structure model; the prior-session low/high is never a fallback recommendation.
forbidden: asking for a short/mid/long horizon to select a different exit model
renaming buy-entry bands as exit advice
inferring user cost, shares or buy date
claiming current unrealized P/L from stale or unverified price as if live
blocking deterministic holding management solely because OOS is FAIL or INSUFFICIENT
inventing a sell price when verified structure is unavailable
using the prior-session low/high as a fallback numeric exit/pressure recommendation

scanner.purpose: Show up to five recent research candidates per verified industry using completed-session official price facts, liquidity and known Taiwan risk flags. This is not a predictive TOP10 model.
forbidden: uncalibrated win rate
fake probability
filling a sector to five with ineligible stocks
calling completed-session facts live prices

output_contract.missing_text: 資料未取得／未通過驗證

levels.B: company IR or two independent quality sources

news_events.rule: Missing event data must remain unknown. A headline alone must never alter a stock decision, and missing event data must never be converted into 'no event'.
